title: Provider connections
description: Share one URL and key per connection. The page and YAML edit the same local configuration; cloud models stay independent.
migrate_description: Group {{count}} legacy models by URL, key, protocol and path. Keep stable IDs, capabilities and task references. Old records are removed only after saving succeeds. Cloud models are unchanged.
bind_description: The selected file will manage local providers. The previous file is not deleted, and legacy or cloud models are not changed. Preserve stable model IDs used by existing tasks.
file_hint: After editing externally, click Reload. Invalid files retain the last valid configuration. Page saves check for changes made by another editor.
empty: Add a provider or bind an existing YAML file, then add models in bulk.
delete_description: Delete “{{name}}”? Its models will no longer be selectable. Task history and cloud models will not be deleted.
name: Connection name
key_keep: Configured; leave blank to keep the current key
key_hint: Keys entered here use encrypted local credential storage; YAML stores a reference. Never commit a hand-edited file containing plaintext keys.
inherits_connection: Models inherit this provider’s connection details; no repeated URL or key entry.
paste_hint: One model ID per line, or comma-separated
discovery_hint: Discovery does not verify model or tool-calling compatibility. Manual entry remains available without a model-list endpoint.
no_new_models: Enter or select at least one model that has not been added.
discard_description: Changes in this form have not been saved to the model file.
